title: RHC Canon Intake Promotion Instruction
description: Minimal repository-side promotion instruction for Canon Intake (CI-04): a deterministic plan that binds one CI-01 candidate, its explicit CI-02 human approval, its CI-02.1 material envelope, and its CI-03 collision result into a legal owner route for the later authoritative write. The instruction is intent, not a write: it carries no persistence mechanism, no SQL/Git executor, and no second generation counter, and recording it never promotes anything. Only a classified candidate with an explicit human-approved CI-02 decision and a CI-03 collision result of exactly clear is eligible; eligibility and lineage binding are enforced by scripts/validate_intake_promotions.py against the CI-01/02/02.1/03 sets, not by this schema. The candidate's source/provenance lineage stays attached through candidate_id and is deliberately never duplicated here (additionalProperties false rejects any attempt). resolved_target is the explicit resolved owner/target and must exactly equal the referenced material envelope's proposed_target kind + reference, so a proposed target cannot be silently rerouted. route is the explicit route class (runtime_save | repository_canon); unknown routes fail closed and the route is never inferred from material prose. expected_collision_result records the explicit requirement that the collision result is clear.

promotion_id.description: Stable, typed, set-unique promotion identity: the prefix is always promotion: followed by a lowercase slug. A duplicate promotion_id within one validated promotion set fails closed, as does a second distinct instruction for the same candidate.

candidate_id.description: Referenced CI-01 candidate identity, using the exact intake_candidate.schema.json grammar: candidate: followed by a lowercase slug. The instruction references and never rewrites the candidate; source/provenance truth stays attached through the referenced candidate. Only a classified candidate with a valid explicit human-approved CI-02 decision is promotion-eligible.

route.description: Explicit resolved route class. runtime_save: mutable operational state that must flow through the existing RT01 Save Gateway and its exact publish/mirror/confirm lifecycle. repository_canon: static/authored/canon owner updates that belong on repository main through the existing repository-authorized workflow. The vocabulary is intentionally closed and minimal; a value outside it fails closed, and the route is never inferred from material prose or target names.

resolved_target.description: The explicit resolved owner/target the material is proposed to land on (kind + reference, both non-blank). It must exactly equal the referenced CI-02.1 material envelope's proposed_target kind + reference; a mismatch is a silent reroute and fails closed. It is an explicit resolution result, never an AI guess.

kind.description: Non-blank free-form target kind (for example npc, location, item, quest).

reference.description: Non-blank target reference (for example an entity_id, a name, or another stable identifier of the proposed destination).

material_type.description: Required non-blank material linkage label: it must equal the referenced CI-02.1 material envelope's material_type. The envelope remains the material owner; the instruction references it rather than duplicating the payload.

decision_id.description: Referenced CI-02 decision identity, using the exact intake_decision.schema.json grammar. It must resolve to a valid decision whose candidate_id equals this instruction's candidate_id and whose outcome is approved by human authority; a decision belonging to a different candidate fails closed.

collision_id.description: Referenced CI-03 collision-result identity, using the exact intake_collision.schema.json grammar. It must resolve to a valid collision result whose candidate_id equals this instruction's candidate_id and whose result is exactly clear; any other result (duplicate/stale/conflict/unresolved) fails closed.

expected_collision_result.description: The instruction's explicit declared expectation about the referenced CI-03 result. It is exactly clear: promotion is only ever expected against an authoritative collision-clear result, and any other value is structurally impossible.

note.description: Optional non-blank human note about the promotion plan; logistics metadata only and never a source of authority.
